hotel.name: Grand Hyatt Shanghai
hotel.address: Jin Mao Tower, 88 Century Avenue, Pudong, Shanghai
addressChinese: 上海市浦东新区世纪大道88号

airport.name: Shanghai Airport Authority / Shanghai.gov
airport.scope: Official taxi pickup at T1 Gate 12 and T2 Gate 25; Line 2 at Pudong.

desk.name: Shanghai.gov / International Services Shanghai
desk.scope: 24-hour help desks near international arrivals exits in T1 and T2.

airportLink.name: Shanghai.gov / Airport Link timetable
airportLink.scope: Published regular last Airport Link departure at 22:15.

metro.name: Shanghai Metro / Metro ticketing guidance
metro.scope: Single-journey tickets and service-counter card payments; a specific card may still be declined.

route.name: Amap / Shanghai Metro line map
route.scope: Line 2 connects Pudong Airport Terminal 1&2 station and Lujiazui.

hyatt.name: Hyatt / Grand Hyatt Shanghai
hyatt.scope: Exact property, Chinese address and published phone; not a reservation or late-arrival confirmation.

nightBus.name: Shanghai Airport Group / Late Night Bus
nightBus.scope: Published T2 window 23:03 to 05:33 next day, with a stop at Century Avenue Metro Station (not the hotel).

parkHyatt.name: Hyatt / Park Hyatt Shanghai
parkHyatt.scope: A different property at 100 Century Avenue, in Shanghai World Financial Center.

late.label: Late night · T2
late.context: First visit · No mobile data on arrival · Hotel already booked
late.verdict: Take an official taxi from Arrival Gate 25.
late.finding: Do not plan around the Airport Link. Its published regular last departure is 22:15, earlier than your scheduled landing.
late.switch: If the taxi queue or payment falls through, ask the 24-hour airport service desk about the Late Night Bus. Use it only if you can confirm the ticket and the onward leg from Century Avenue Metro Station.

route.title: Before boarding
route.body: Save the address card and airport plan offline. Ask the hotel to hold your room if check-in slips past midnight.

route.title: After baggage claim
route.body: Follow official taxi signs to the stand outside T2 Arrival Gate 25. Show the Chinese card and ask about payment before boarding.

route.title: At the hotel
route.body: Match Grand Hyatt Shanghai and Jin Mao Tower on the card. Keep your booking confirmation offline for the front desk.

fallback.title: No data or dead phone
fallback.body: Use the saved image or printed card. In international arrivals, look for International Services Shanghai; the desk is advertised as open 24 hours.

fallback.title: QR payment or card declined
fallback.body: Ask whether the driver accepts RMB cash before boarding; carry a cash backup if possible. If you have no accepted way to pay, ask the airport desk for help.

fallback.title: Taxi queue not workable
fallback.body: The airport lists a late-night bus from T2, 23:03 to 05:33 the next day. Ask the desk to confirm where to board, how to pay and how to reach the hotel from Century Avenue Metro Station. Do not board if your onward leg is still unclear.

fallback.title: No room-hold confirmation
fallback.body: Contact the hotel before departure. If your arrival slips into the next date, use the number on the card when you have a connection. Do not assume the room is held.

late.hotelTask: Confirm the property and ask whether it will keep your room if you arrive after midnight.
late.message: Hello, I have a booking for [date] at Grand Hyatt Shanghai. My flight lands at Pudong late and I may reach the hotel after midnight. Could you confirm the correct entrance and that my room will be held? Thank you.
late.recheck: Operating flight, terminal, taxi pickup and late hotel check-in. Do not assume availability or a quoted fare.

deskPhrase.heading: Show the airport desk if you need the night bus
deskPhrase.english: Where do I board and buy a ticket? How do I get from Century Avenue Metro Station to Jin Mao Tower?
chinese: 请问守航夜宵线在哪里上车？怎么购票？
从世纪大道地铁站到金茂大厦怎么走？

day.label: Daytime · T1
day.context: First visit · Light luggage · No mobile payments set up
day.verdict: Take Metro Line 2 to Lujiazui if it is running normally.
day.finding: A daytime arrival with light luggage makes Line 2 practical. You do not have to rely on a phone-based metro QR code.
day.switch: If Line 2 is disrupted, ticket payment fails or carrying bags becomes impractical, use the official T1 taxi stand outside Arrival Gate 12.

route.title: Before boarding
route.body: Save the Chinese address card and the Metro Line 2 destination name. Keep a physical payment backup accessible.

route.title: After baggage claim
route.body: Follow Metro signs to Pudong Airport Terminal 1&2 station. Ask the service counter for a single-journey ticket to Lujiazui.

route.title: After leaving the Metro
route.body: At Lujiazui, show the card if you need directions to Jin Mao Tower. Follow current station signs; the sample does not assume a specific lift or exit is open.

fallback.title: No app or working QR code
fallback.body: Ask the service counter for a single-journey ticket. The city lists international bank cards as a counter payment option; your card is not guaranteed to work.

fallback.title: Metro disrupted or bags too heavy
fallback.body: Go back to the official T1 taxi pickup outside Arrival Gate 12. Confirm an accepted way to pay before boarding and show the hotel card.

fallback.title: Which Hyatt is yours?
fallback.body: Grand Hyatt Shanghai is in Jin Mao Tower at 88 Century Avenue. Park Hyatt Shanghai is a different property at 100 Century Avenue. Show the full Chinese address rather than the Hyatt brand name alone.

day.hotelTask: Verify the exact property and ask where to leave luggage if you reach the hotel before your room is ready.
day.message: Hello, I have a booking for [date] at Grand Hyatt Shanghai in Jin Mao Tower. I may arrive before my room is ready. Could you tell me which entrance to use and whether I can leave my luggage first? Thank you.
day.recheck: Operating flight, terminal, Line 2 service, the hotel entrance and luggage storage policy.
